case_leaks._note: Terms come from the case: each linked person's name, the name without leading initials, each part around ' alias ', and each alias (3+ characters); from the address, the landmark after near/opp/opposite/behind/next to (up to the next comma) and, when the address starts with a door number, the door number plus the street after it (6+ characters). A plain road or locality is NOT a term: the area label names the road on purpose. Whole-word, case-insensitive, whitespace-insensitive.
